questions.question_text: What is Biomedical Science primarily focused on?

options.text: Designing bridges and buildings using engineering principles
Combining biology and technology to solve health-related problems
Studying weather patterns and climate change
Developing new software for gaming applications

correct_answer.text: Combining biology and technology to solve health-related problems

questions.question_text: Which body system is responsible for pumping blood and delivering oxygen throughout the body?
What is the primary function of an MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) machine in medical technology?

options.text: To take images of bones using radiation
To provide detailed images of soft tissues like muscles and brain using magnets and radio waves
To replace damaged limbs with robotic parts
To measure heart rate and steps through wearable sensors

correct_answer.text: To provide detailed images of soft tissues like muscles and brain using magnets and radio waves

questions.question_text: In the context of engineering solutions for health, what is the first step in the design process for creating a medical device?

options.text: Building a prototype of the device
Testing the device in real-world conditions
Identifying a specific health problem to solve
Finalizing the product for mass production

correct_answer.text: Identifying a specific health problem to solve

questions.question_text: What is a key ethical concern related to gene editing in Biomedical Science?

options.text: Whether it is too expensive to develop new medical devices
Whether it should be used to alter non-medical traits like appearance in humans
Whether it requires too much time to test for safety
Whether it can be used to improve computer software

correct_answer.text: Whether it should be used to alter non-medical traits like appearance in humans
